learned: The phone shows modules as cards; the red number is work waiting.
The bottom tabs are Rooms, Arrivals, Bookings, Folios and Menu.
The magnifier in the app bar searches pages and actions.

quiz.q: Which five tabs are at the bottom?
quiz.a: Rooms, Arrivals, Bookings, Folios and Menu.

quiz.q: What does the badge on the Arrivals tab count?
quiz.a: The arrivals still to check in.

quiz.q: Where do you sign out?

learned: Tapping an arrival opens the guided check-in at Step 2, Verify guest.
The steps are Find, Verify guest, Room, Tariff, Advance and Check in.
The ID is checked and shown masked; the purpose of visit is compulsory.

quiz.q: Which step comes after Verify guest?
What is needed before Check in?
Is an advance compulsory at check-in?

learned: The room board filters by status and floor.
An attendant starts a task, ticks the checklist and completes the cleaning; the supervisor inspects.
A fault found while cleaning is reported with Report repair.

quiz.q: What must be ticked before Complete cleaning works?
Who sees only their own rooms?
Where do you report a fault from the room card?

learned: My guest requests lists the requests assigned to you.
Start and Complete take the request through its time target; Complete asks for a note.
Found item logs anything found in a room.

quiz.q: What does Start do?
quiz.a: It stops the waiting time and starts the work time.

quiz.q: What does Complete ask for?
quiz.a: A short note for the guest.

quiz.q: Where do you log a found charger?

learned: My work orders lists the jobs by priority.
A repair request becomes a work order with Create work order.
A job is completed with the parts booked and a note.

quiz.q: What does Create work order do?
quiz.a: It turns a repair request into a tracked job.

quiz.q: What does Complete need?
quiz.a: A note of what you did.

quiz.q: Does the technician see prices?

learned: A folio opens from the Folios tab with its charges, receipts and requests.
Laundry is posted from the catalogue at 18 per cent GST.
A UPI payment needs a reference and a confirmation.

quiz.q: Which GST rate does laundry carry?
What does UPI need?
Which button finishes the payment?

learned: The Approvals inbox has Requests, Expenses and Audit log.
The manager approves an expense after reading it.
Day closing shows the steps and what blocks the close.

quiz.q: Who approves staff expenses?
Where do you see what blocks the day close?
Does the phone follow the same close order as the PC?

learned: My shifts & pay shows your own shift, week, payslips and leave.
Request leave sends the request to a manager.
Appearance & display sets the text size of this device only.

quiz.q: Whose pay do you see?
Who approves your leave?
Does a text-size change affect other phones?
quiz.a: No, it belongs to this device.

fkeys: All modules, display mode, sign out

keyboard: Back (or Esc) closes the top-most sheet
The tabs are always at the bottom
passwords: Demo users: choose a name with Preview as. No passwords in the training build.
reference_lines.keyboard_narration: Back closes the top-most sheet. Tap the magnifier to search. The tabs are always at the bottom.
reference_lines.passwords_narration: The training build has demo users that you choose by name. There are no passwords.
